segments.text: We first tried Point-of-Sale (POS) in 208. At the time, competition mattered because customers were asking for digital receipts.
The biggest issue was Access to finance. Without steady power in Lagos, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Point-of-Sale (POS)—we saw Operational efficiency within 6 months.
Policy-wise, Import duty waivers shaped our move. We adjusted by Alternative power.
Data helped; even a low-code AutoML gave us clearer demand patterns during Christmas.
